$comment: 📜️ One SHELL-chrome journey step per case, with the action journal each renderer publishes for it. `react` is MEASURED, never designed: it is the per-step `actions` of the 2026-09-18 side-by-side parity run (ticket 26/09/17/WGPU-RENDERER-REACT-PARITY, `🗑️generated/w12c-parity-run-19/steps.json`), as action ids in order. `wgpu` is the contract this shell answers, and every row where the two differ carries `why`. The twin of `🌐️World3dHost/🧫️fixtures/📜️journal-sequences.json`, which owns the world surface's own rows; this file owns the dock/chord rows the shell itself journals. `control` is the id the probe's resolution ladder lands on, so a row is reproducible without the probe.

steps.why: React's Focus chip is `dock.activateWindow(tab.id)` plus `dock.toggleMaximize(stackPath)` (`🖱️ui/🧱️elements/🎨️Canvas/🟦️.tsx:1076-1086`). The maximize is local state `🏛️ShellHost/🟦️.tsx` notes NOWHERE — it declares no `shell.windowMaximize` command at all — and the activation is journaled separately by `handleActiveWindowChange` (`:10392`), which fires only on a real change. In the journey the clicked window is already active, so the step is silent on both renderers.

The ONE row where this shell deliberately does not match the measured React column. React's `closeWindow` → `onWindowClose` notes `shell.windowClose` with the closed window (`🏛️ShellHost/🟦️.tsx:10530-10531`) — the note that makes the entry invertible. React journaled nothing in run 19 because its cap chip is OCCLUDED: its Catalogue panel paints from y≈28 over the left stack's cap row at y=32..61, so the click lands on the panel (`📓️w13a-dock-close-reopen-journals.md` §4, `🗑️generated/w12c-parity-run-19/react/15-split-gutter-drag.png`). Zero `shell.windowClose` in 104589 React console lines and both windows alive until step 36. Owner of the divergence: the panel-anchor lane, not the dock.

There is no reopen verb on either renderer. The probe resolves 'the dock tab' by scanning the published control rows, and the row it lands on must not be destructive: React's scan lands on the `mode-dock-tabbar` container (`pointer-events-none`, so the click falls through) and this shell's lands on the survivor's SELECT target, already active. Before W13a the chips were published before the select target and the scan landed on `….close`, closing the last world pane and leaving `docked=0` for every step below.

UNRESOLVED. React's `role-editor` journals one extra `noteShellCommand` (run 19 `seq 274`, origin `user`, dispatch window `puzzle3d-main-top`) and its `role-viewer` journals none. The command id is not recoverable from run 19 — `InputLedgerRecordV1` carries no args (`🏛️ShellHost/🎯️input-ledger/🟦️.ts:163`) — and the two candidates that fit (`shell.windowActivate` on the editor landing, `shell.panelTab` on the two panels the editor mount restores) need different fixes. This shell's witness refuses an instance-crossing landing on purpose (`window_activation_is_user_v1`), which is what keeps `role-viewer` silent; relaxing it would break that row instead. Settle it by carrying the noted command id into the ledger record and re-running the probe.
